label: NZEUG participant recalls early Dunedin meeting
summary: Rachel Summers, an early GIS educator, recalled attending what she described as the first NZEUG meeting in Dunedin in 1994. The group's own account dates its formation to 1992; the distinction remains open.

sources.label: NZEUG committee profile of Rachel Summers, 2026, recalling first Dunedin meeting in 1994
